Director Sundar C Addresses Speculation Regarding AI Usage in 'Mookuthi Amman 2'

01 Nov 2026, 10:38 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

Addressing Technical Speculation

Director Sundar C has responded to public commentary regarding the visual effects in his upcoming film, *Mookuthi Amman 2*. Speaking at a promotional event in Chennai, the filmmaker sought to clarify the production process behind the movie's graphics, specifically addressing claims that the film relied entirely on artificial intelligence (AI).

According to Sundar C, while AI was utilized during post-production, its application was limited. He stated that out of approximately 3,000 visual effects shots included in the final cut, AI technology was employed in only 15. The director emphasized that the vast majority of the visual work was the result of manual labor by a large team of technicians.

Production Scale and Team Effort

Sundar C highlighted the significant resources invested in the film's visual presentation, noting the following details regarding the production:

  • Development Timeline: The project underwent a development and production period spanning approximately one-and-a-half to two years.
  • Workforce: The production team reportedly included around 400 to 800 individuals working on the visual effects, with many contributing significant hours to the effort.
  • Professional Contribution: The director attributed the visual output to the work of Tamil technicians, urging audiences to acknowledge the manual effort involved before assessing the quality of the technical work.

Response to Criticism

In his comments, Sundar C expressed that while he remains open to constructive criticism, he finds inaccuracies regarding the production process discouraging. He invited viewers to judge the film based on their experience in the theatre rather than speculating on the methods used during its creation.

"If you like the visuals, appreciate the team. If something is not good, give us your feedback," the director stated, emphasizing a willingness to incorporate audience perspectives for future projects.

Film Overview

*Mookuthi Amman 2* is scheduled for a theatrical release on November 6. The film features a cast including Nayanthara, Regina Cassandra, Urvashi, and Yogi Babu, with a musical score composed by Hiphop Tamizha Adhi. Unlike its predecessor, this installment is directed by Sundar C and follows a narrative involving a queen protecting her son from an encroaching supernatural force.

To verify specific details regarding the film's technical production or to review the film upon release, audiences are encouraged to monitor official announcements from the production house or engage with the film through its theatrical exhibition.
